OMNIPRESENCE.dashboard.duplicatesHeading: Duplicate sync ids — resolve by unenrolling one copy
OMNIPRESENCE.dashboard.duplicatesHint: Each id below is carried by more than one document, or by a document that is not bound to it while a shared copy of it already exists (made here or in another world). Those documents do not sync. To settle a row, remove the extra documents from sync. Remove from Sync in the tables below updates this list straight away; a removal made anywhere else (by a player, or from the sidebar menu) shows at the next GM login. When exactly one of an id's documents is left in sync, that document is bound and syncs again; while none of them is in sync, the row stays listed. A row listed with the existing shared copy is never bound automatically: it stays listed while one of its documents is in sync, and goes away once none is.
OMNIPRESENCE.macroConfirm.title: Omnipresence — Install Script Macros?
OMNIPRESENCE.macroConfirm.intro: These script macros for your hotbar are new here or were changed in another world. A script macro runs with your GM permissions: install them only if you recognise the code. Skipped macros are offered again at your next login.
